Haiku:
Nazis persecute,
Schindler sees Jewish workers,
Saves many lives.

Simba's father dies,
Bitter uncle takes the throne,
Lion king returns.

Ronin seeks to die,
A past tale of harsh suicide,
Clan's honor at stake.

Rebels face the cold,
Luke learns ways of the Force,
Vader hunts them all.
